# Feature Name

| Attribute | Value |
| --- | --- |
| **Status** | Draft / active / implemented / retired |
| **Owner** | State and code owner |
| **Last verified** | YYYY-MM-DD |
| **Source of truth** | Source files and tests |

## User purpose

What problem does this solve, in user language?

## Ownership boundary

What state does this feature own, and what belongs elsewhere?

## Intended experience

Describe the smallest understandable user flow and important states.

## Contracts and data flow

List routes, settings keys, events, schemas, persistence, and trust boundaries.

## Implementation status

Separate implemented behavior from intended behavior and known gaps.

## Source anchors

Link exact implementation and test files.

## Acceptance criteria

Write observable outcomes that can be verified.

## Decisions and open questions

Link decision records. Keep unresolved choices explicit.
